description: Land Title Settlement Department - Moragollagama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420911
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and property encumbrances for multiple land parcels in Moragollagama village. The document is specifically published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette, confirming its focus on land and property-related administrative matters, which aligns perfectly with the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
